name: agent-app-skill
title: 应用实践：写一个 Skill，把检验数据整理成能分享的报告

assertions.name: 报告字段完整（五项都在）
每一轮都有答复（≥10 字）
assertions.expr: Array.isArray(out.turns) && out.turns.length >= 1 && out.turns.every((t) => typeof t.reply === 'string' && t.reply.trim().length >= 10)

assertions.name: 轮数与每轮的指标行计数都对（含「只列异常」生效与「忘掉」恢复）
assertions.expr: out.turns.length === expected.turn_replies && JSON.stringify(out.turns.map((t) => t.counts && [t.counts.total, t.counts.abnormal, t.counts.listed])) === JSON.stringify(expected.turn_counts.map((c) => c && [c.total, c.abnormal, c.listed]))

assertions.name: 报告四节齐全 / 顺序与模板一致 / 每节写到最小篇幅
assertions.expr: JSON.stringify(out.report.sections.map((s) => s.name)) === JSON.stringify(expected.report.section_names) && out.report.sections.every((s, i) => typeof s.content === 'string' && s.content.trim().length >= expected.report.section_min_chars[i])

assertions.name: 指标表逐行正确（item / value / unit / flag）
assertions.expr: JSON.stringify(out.report.metric_rows.map((r) => [r.item, r.value, r.unit, r.flag])) === JSON.stringify(expected.report.metric_rows.map((r) => [r.item, r.value, r.unit, r.flag]))

assertions.name: 计数自洽（异常 = 指标表里非 normal 的行数；总行数对得上）
assertions.expr: out.report.counts.abnormal === expected.report.counts.abnormal && out.metrics.total_rows === out.report.counts.total && out.metrics.abnormal_rows === out.report.counts.abnormal && out.metrics.listed_rows === out.report.counts.listed

assertions.name: 越界行的升级条数与 expected 一致（越界只提示复核）
诊断式提问被拒答，且拒答轮不给引用
assertions.expr: JSON.stringify(out.turns.map((t) => t.refusals)) === JSON.stringify(expected.turn_refusals) && out.turns.filter((t) => t.refusals > 0).every((t) => !t.citations || t.citations.length === 0)

assertions.name: 图与说明齐全（至少 1 张，含一句话结论）
assertions.expr: Array.isArray(out.figures) && out.figures.length >= 1 && out.figures.every((f) => f && typeof f.path === 'string' && f.path.trim() !== '' && typeof f.takeaway === 'string' && f.takeaway.trim().length >= 10)

assertions.name: 说清口径与局限（notes ≥60 字）
